subject: Unsafe and chaotic event on 18 Oct - need management response

The venue was clearly oversold, the exit gate near Block C was blocked, and a girl near us fainted in the crush while staff stood around with no medical help or water. When we asked a steward what was going on he said it's not his job. The promotional posts said 'premium experience, limited entry' which was plain untrue. I would like a proper response from the senior management about what went wrong, and I would also like to be told whether the 12,800 we paid will be reviewed, but my main concern is that someone could have been seriously hurt. I am prepared to share my photos and videos with the local press if I do not get a real answer. Sandeep Malhotra

The decor team arrived 3 hours late, half the floral arrangements were missing, the DJ equipment was not what was in our signed quote, and the coordinator Ms. Rekha stopped answering her phone after 6 pm. I raised it with your customer care on 4 October and again on 9 October and have only received an automated acknowledgement. I would now like a call from you or a senior manager within 3 days to discuss what happened. If not, I will have to pursue this through legal means and share the full details publicly. Sincerely, Anita Rao-D'Souza
